description: One SuliHuli page in full as Markdown, the same text as its .md address: an answer, a guide, a ranking, a brand, a model or its sources and charging pages, incentives, the method or a legal page. Use it after search, or with any SuliHuli address you have. Long pages come in parts of up to 8 000 characters including navigation: the first part includes a contents list with part numbers; pass part for the next. Quote figures with the source and status the page prints.

id.description: The id from search, or any SuliHuli address: a path such as '/answers/how-long-to-install-home-ev-charger' or '/m/kia-ev9/sources', or the full URL.

locale.description: Language of the answer's text and page links (default en): en.

part.description: Part of a long page, 1-based (default 1); see total_parts.

name: fetch

cite.description: The page to link when the answer uses it.

contents.description: Headings with their part (first part of a long page).

markdown.description: The text of this part of the page as Markdown, the same as the text content.

title: Read a SuliHuli page whole
